I wrote the code map of what exists today for working together through GitHub, with file:line at c15d75e. It has six mapped sections, a table of 14 root causes (R1 to R14) and a list of where the re-plan brief no longer matches the code. I edited nothing in the repository and ran no tests.

- **Built in run C:** the Work together path (the repository-use module, the creation check, the settings, the activity rule over pull requests in any state). A together project writes nothing to GitHub. Each Forerunner lists only its own pull requests, through its task rows.
- **Not built, though the brief describes them:** OJ-11 (cut in C4 and sent to wave 8), the chat `project.create` together flag, and the information-only listing of a joined project's docs pull requests.
- **The status issue has no code at all.** No issue method is ever called. Editing a comment, pin, ETag/304 reads, issues-off detection and issue authors are missing from the GitHost interface, the GitHub adapter and the in-memory host. The fake HTTP host already has comment edit and delete, the creator filter, several users, an organisation and per-user tokens. The bench stand-in has one user, and each bench starts its own stand-in, so two homes cannot share one.
- **W15-01 root cause:** when an open pull request is on `fr/docs-scaffold`, the scaffold decides ownership from the pull request body alone. Its fallback is "this project is the only one linked here". It never reads the branch's own marker file while a pull request is open. The same fallback serves the status pull request, the Docs tab list and the Pull requests list with Merge.
- **Phone start root cause:** the phone's plain start asks only about a refused credential, then goes straight to the scheduler.
- **Other gaps and risks:** the plan-only block, the task brief and the pre-claim overlap check have no announced or merged work to read. Decision files are always numbered 0001. Every agent defaults to "Alice". "Spent CHF x" reaches GitHub through docs/status.md when the status pull request is on. `/health` can name the wrong store. The together test's second person is a view whose writes carry the first person's login.
key_facts: W15-01 root cause: when a pull request is open on fr/docs-scaffold, the scaffold returns that branch at once (loop/docs.ts:971) and reads the branch's marker file only when none is open (:974-978). isProjectDocsPr then falls back to soleLinked (:247), and ownsUnmarkedDocs counts taken-over ids as the project's own (:287-291). So the scaffold and Try again push onto another project's unmarked pull request and comment on it (:1052-1063). The same fallback is used for status (:267, :1155), docsInPullRequests (:1323) and the Pull requests list with Merge (daemon/pull-requests.ts:413-415, :512-515).

Phone start root cause: refusedStart (daemon/compose.ts:4082-4106) answers only for a refused-credential wait. RemoteCommandWatcher.runStart calls kill.resume() and then scheduler.requestStart (remote/watcher.ts:779-800), skipping POST /sessions' other refusals: refuseOverMonth (server.ts:1647-1666), nothing runnable, the one-wait rule, a removed project.

Work together exists: RepositoryUse.check (sources/repository-use.ts:862-969); readRepository reads the marker, then listPullRequests with state all and sort updated (first 100), then whoAmI (:509-543); elsewhereOf applies the 14-day rule by authorLogin, and an unknown author counts as another account (:594-616). createProjectRecord adopts the repository's id and writes settings.together {name, at, activeOn, login} (daemon/create-project.ts:89, :114-134).

A together project writes nothing to GitHub: isProjectDocsPr, isProjectStatusPr and ownsUnmarkedDocs return false for it (loop/docs.ts:223, :264, :286); its scaffold only refreshes the copy (:846-864); its status stays in the app (:1144); its first plan is plan-only (session/intake.ts:2150). The status pull request is off by default for every project (C-57, docs.ts:120-125), so today no Forerunner tells the other anything on GitHub except through pull requests.

OJ-11 (Work together for a project already here, closing its status pull request) was cut in C4 and sent to wave 8 (/tmp/frbench/leftovers-C4.json). Only the pair rule exists (daemon/join-preview.ts:203-205). The Overview line offers only Take it over (repository-use.ts:1052-1058). The chat together flag is not built either: createParams (commands/src/commands/project.ts:230-236) has no together field, and chat answers with CHAT_TOGETHER_HINT.

GitHost (capabilities/githost/types.ts:259-398) has createIssue, updateIssue, listIssues and commentOnIssue. IssueInfo has no author, ids or updatedAt; CommentInfo has no updatedAt; RepoInfo has no hasIssues. Missing: comment edit, pin, lock, ETag/304, issues off. listIssues in github.ts:665-673 reads one page with no paging. No runtime code calls any issue method.

Fake HTTP host (testenv/src/githost/routes-issues.ts) has issue CRUD, comment create/list/get/PATCH/DELETE (:141-246, any writer may edit), the creator and direction filters, and per-user tokens, orgs and collaborators (fake-git-host.ts:161-216). It has no ETag/304, no pin (GraphQL), no lock, and has_issues is always true (store.ts:452).

Bench --githost (scripts/bench/start.mjs:79-103, githost-server.ts:30-38) starts one stand-in per bench with one user 'bench', one token and two repositories; a second bench cannot attach to it. MemoryGitHost stamps authorLogin = this.login (memory.ts:248), so Bob's Object.create view in onerepo-together.test.ts:39-40 would write as Alice.

Task branch is fr/<last 8 hex of the task id>-<title> (pr-executor.ts:529-537), so the same work never shares a branch across Forerunners. The task pull request's hidden mark carries project=<shared id> (pr-executor.ts:3127), which is how the maker counts the together Forerunner's activity.

Marker .forerunner/project.json is {schema, project, name} (sources/marker.ts:14-24), written by the scaffold (docs.ts mark) and by intake.ts:2716, never by a together project. Nothing writes AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. STANDARD_DOCS still includes docs/status.md (packages/memory/src/docs.ts:10-19), against the owner's 'No docs/status.md in repositories'.

The intake's docs branch is fr/intake-<8 hex of the project id>-<name>-docs (intake.ts:173-183), keyed by the project id that a together project shares. Decision files are fixed at docs/decisions/0001-<slug>.md (intake.ts:203); nothing allocates a later number.

Where announced and merged work could enter as data: PlanOnly {tasks} and alreadyInProjectBlock (intake.ts:2145-2151, :2187-2192, :2746-2788); taskContextBlock (session/task-context.ts:331-443); the pre-claim overlap check (session/runner.ts:2609-2646 with peers.ts detectOverlap/pathsOverlap); the default-head poll every 60 s (githost-watcher.ts:587-620). Chat RECALL_KINDS has no status kind (conversation/recall-steps.ts:15-25).

Install identity: the desktop device row id (remote/presence.ts:54-91), registered on every store whenever the services run. Agent name defaults to 'Alice' (compose.ts:1752); commit author is '<agent> (Forerunner)' with the person's email (compose.ts:2710-2715). permissions.push is mapped (github.ts:1169-1178) but read nowhere in runtime.

Shared-store leftovers: ownsProject reads members/shared_with/author_human (commands/src/ownership.ts:21-33); shared_with is a setting (commands/src/commands/settings.ts:506-515); there is no project.share command; every project gets members:[own agent] (create-project.ts:100). /health reports rt.config.stateUrl (server.ts:657), not compose's env-first stateUrl (compose.ts:1638-1643).

Costs reach GitHub: the session's endedNote 'Spent CHF x' (runner.ts:4167-4170) is written into docs/status.md (memory/src/docs.ts:303) and pushed on fr/status when the status pull request is on (loop/docs.ts:1166-1174). The Projects mirror also has a cost field (projects-mirror.ts:92, :324-327); it is opt-in, behind an approval card.

Two-home tests: onerepo-together.test.ts (two composed homes on one MemoryGitHost with a restart; B never runs a task; both agents are named 'Alice'; not driven through the UI client). Not written: apps/ui/test/two-installs.ts, a two-user fake-HTTP case, a two-home bench.

plan.summary:
The wave 8 plan is in /tmp/frbench/wave8-plan.json, built against c15d75e: 12 areas, 5 sub-runs, 134 items. A build script checked the file's shape. I changed nothing in the repository and ran no tests. HEAD moved to 8262c31 while I worked, but that commit only touches NEXT-SESSION.md, so every code line number still holds.

**Areas.** Ten are wave 8's own and follow the brief's six groups in order:
- collab-bench became w8-two-homes.
- status-issue-host became w8-issue-host.
- repo-guide became w8-repo-guide.
- status-issue-write became w8-status-write.
- w8-together is new: OJ-11 and chat's Work together, which run C never built.
- status-issue-read became w8-status-read.
- collab-feed and collab-live became one area, w8-github-feed.
- collab-shared-repo became w8-shared-repo; it also builds the agent names, which share a root cause with commit authors.
- collab-identity's guard and the slimmed collab-claims became one area, w8-own-devices.
- collab-journey became w8-journey.

The other two areas, w8-l4-leftovers and w8-l4-leftovers-chat, hold 19 run L4 leftovers each.

**Things that differ from what the step asked:**
- **12 areas, not about 10, and two leftovers areas, not one.** Run L4 left 53 class (c) items. I folded 15 into the wave 8 areas whose files they touch. The other 38 would not fit one fixer session (run L4's largest area held 19).
- **The phone's plain start (L4i-left-1, never cut, money) is in w8-own-devices, not phase H.** That area builds one start check shared by POST /sessions, chat and the remote watcher, and the routing allowed this.
- **L4i-left-48 and L4i-left-65 are in w8-status-read**, because the GitHub read before planning sits on the same route.

**Sub-runs.** All five are listed above. W8a builds the base every later one needs: the two-home harness and bench, the issue calls on all three hosts, and the guide.

**Placements the step required.** W15-01 (L4i-left-2) is never cut in w8-repo-guide, and its fr/status half goes with w8-status-write. The UpdatesPage me?.id race (L4i-left-3) is in W8a's first area.

**Never-cut items.** There are 37. Each area's first acceptance lines name them with their failing test. The build script checks that, along with the exact area fields, item ids appearing once, and the sub-run and merge order.

**Owner questions and decisions.**
- Only brief questions 12 and 13 go to the owner (see owner_questions).
- 34 decisions (D-W8-1 to D-W8-34). The brief's other open section 8 questions are D-W8-6 to D-W8-16, each marked "session lead, 2026-11-24, from the brief's proposal; the owner can overrule"; question 1 is recorded as decided by the owner (D-W8-1).
- The owner's 2026-11-02 status design and guide decision are carried word for word.
- D-W8-5 lists the three sentences the owner was told that D9 makes untrue.

**Final check additions.**
- F-W8-1 is the zero-cost two-home check in run C's LC-C1 style, against forerunner-sandbox or the stand-in.
- F-W8-2 is the live two-person journey: estimate USD 2.40, cap USD 3.00, stop and report at 2.50.
- runL4-plan.json owner_checklist[0] is reused and extended.

**leftovers_routing.** All 92 classified ids are routed: 65 to areas, 1 to phase H (L4i-left-15), and 26 dropped with their reasons.

**plan_check.** It maps every brief section 4 area, section 5 item, section 8 question and wave8_amendments entry (0 to 16) to an area and item id. It also says where each section 9 rule sits in the acceptance lines, what is left out on purpose and why, and lists the deviations above. Planned new ADRs: 0121 (repo-guide), 0122 (status-write), 0123 (own-devices).

findings.where: w8-own-devices, W8-own-4 (never cut), decision 'A lost claim stops the run', files 'TaskRepo.transition expectedHolder'
findings.problem: The planned lost-claim fix cannot catch the case it now targets. Claims are held by agent id only, and one person's desktop and cloud runner run as the same agent, so a holder check by agent id never sees the loss. The never-cut acceptance ('distinct device ids ... A's run released: it stops within one watch tick') cannot pass without a claim holder that names the runtime (device or session). That needs a task-table change and migration, which the area does not name; it plans only a suite.ts case for expectedHolder.
findings.evidence: packages/state/src/schema.ts:223 claimed_by is 'Agent holding the claim'. packages/state/src/repos/task.ts:139-147 claim() sets claimed_by = agentId and allows a reclaim where claimed_by = the same agent; :182-185 renewClaim matches on claimed_by = agentId. services/cloud-runner/src/config.ts:59 'the human's first principal agent when absent'; services/cloud-runner/src/runner.ts:255-258 resolveAgent returns the first principal, the same one compose.ts:1733-1747 picks on the desktop. wave8-oldplan-mapped.json:316 (the source of this item): 'the watch also stops the run when claimed_by is not agent.id'.
findings.fix: Restate W8-own-4. The claim records which runtime holds it (device id or session id: a new column with a migration on SQLite and Postgres, so FORERUNNER_TEST_PG). renewClaim, the watch and transition check that runtime holder, not the agent id. Name the migration and packages/state/src/schema.ts in files, and add an acceptance case where both runtimes use the same principal agent.

findings.where: w8-status-write, W8-write-3 (never cut) and decisions (writer = install id + login)
findings.problem: The plan says the install id is 'registered on every store'. It is not: the desktop device row is registered only when services run, remote control is on, or it is asked for. The two-home harness composes like onerepo-together.test.ts and real-daemon.test.ts, with startServices: false. There it gets no device row, so the writer key the comment marker and the 'two installs, one login keep two comments' case depend on does not exist.
findings.evidence: packages/runtime/src/daemon/compose.ts:6016 `const registerDevice = services || remoteEnabled || opts.remote?.enabled === true;`, :5999 `const services = opts.startServices !== false;`, :6007 `let remoteDevice: DeviceRow | null = null;`. packages/runtime/test/onerepo-together.test.ts composes with `startServices: false`; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts has 32 `startServices: false` composes. wave8-codemap.md 5.4 says 'registered whenever services run'.
findings.fix: Have w8-status-write (or w8-two-homes' composeTwo) register the install id in every compose that writes status, or pass opts.remote.enabled in the harness. Then correct the root-cause line, and add a harness assertion that each home has a distinct install id.

findings.where: w8-repo-guide, decision D-W8-9 (date-named decisions 'the intake's first decision included'), files list

**Changes that alter what gets built:**
- **Lost claim (blocking finding):** the claim now records which runtime holds it, in a new `task.claimed_device` column with migration 0011 on SQLite and Postgres. `claim`, `renewClaim`, `transition` and the watch all check it. A person's desktop and cloud runner run as the same agent, so checking the agent id alone could never catch the case.
- **Repository placement (blocking finding):** today's default stays: the person's own account, or an organisation only when they name one on the card (ADR 0097). The only new thing in W8-repo-3 is a line after creation saying how a second person gets in.
- **Install id in the status comment:** the comment's hidden marker now carries a non-reversible writer key (a SHA-256 hash of the device row id and the project key), never the raw id. Compose registers the device row whenever the status board is wired, and the test harness asserts each home has its own install id.
- **Commit email:** commits use the login's GitHub noreply address, never the setup email. The bench journey, scenario 10 and both final-check searches now also look at commit authors and committers.
- **Write access:** new never-cut item W8-host-8 reads each login's permission on the repository. One shared writer filter then decides which comments count in the issue body, the reader, the 'On GitHub' block and both Updates lines.
- **Which issue a project writes:** a project writes only the issue keyed by its own id. A non-together project on a repository whose marker names another project writes nothing there, so a join no longer closes or comments on any issue.
- **How long an announcement holds:** freshness comes from GitHub's own timestamps, not the writer's clock, and Paused lines lapse after 14 days unseen. When two announce at once, the edit GitHub stamped first wins, not the older comment.
- **Other additions:** the status issue's off switch is its own item (W8-write-10), and the guide records the issue's state but never its number. Other GitHub text is now guarded too: free text gets redacted, the credential-wait line follows the person's policy, Updates lines that quote GitHub count as records for chat, and there are injection cases for pull request titles and work-in-progress commit messages. Every start path is listed, with one check for the starts the person presses. W8-own-9 (PUT /projects/:id/settings changing caps) is now never cut.
